  Figure Panel  : 1A, 1B, 1C; Supp S2A, S2C, S2D, S2E
  Description   : Somatic mutation landscape of COLOSSUS (WES) and TCGA MSS cohorts.
                  1A COLOSSUS St2/3 MSS RAS-mt oncoplot (top 20 CGC driver genes); 1B TCGA MSS

```{r COLOSSUS-data-prep}

 colossus_maf = read.maf(
   maf = "COLOSSUS_WES_allsamples.maf")
 colossus_maf@summary
 
 colossus_tmp_maf_RAS = subsetMaf(maf = colossus_maf, genes = c("KRAS", "NRAS")) 
 
 colossus_RAS_samples = as.character(colossus_tmp_maf_RAS@variants.per.sample$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)

 colossus_maf_RAS = subsetMaf(maf = colossus_maf, tsb = colossus_RAS_samples)

 head(colossus_maf_RAS@variants.per.sample)
 
 colossus_RAS_samples_rmhypermutators = colossus_maf_RAS@variants.per.sample$Tumor_Sample_Barcode[2:nrow(colossus_maf_RAS@variants.per.sample)]

```

```{r TCGA-data-prep}
# From cBioportal using the project Colorectal Adenocarcinoma TCGA PanCancer data
cbioportal_clinical = read_tsv("cbioportal_data_clinical_sample.tsv")
cbioportal_maf = read.maf("cbioportal_mutations.maf")

# Subset clinical data to only include patients with mutation data
cbioportal_clinical = cbioportal_clinical[cbioportal_clinical$SAMPLE_ID %in% cbioportal_maf@variants.per.sample$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, ]

# Check if any patients have two or more samples. Should be TRUE if all unique.
# all(!duplicated(substr(cbioportal_maf@variants.per.sample$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 1,12)))

# Splitting samples by MSIsensor score of 20. Score<20 is MSS. Score>=20 is MSI.  
tcga_mss_samples = cbioportal_clinical$SAMPLE_ID[cbioportal_clinical$MSI_SENSOR_SCORE<20]
tcga_msi_samples = cbioportal_clinical$SAMPLE_ID[cbioportal_clinical$MSI_SENSOR_SCORE>=20]

# Creating a subset of clinical data for mss only
cbioportal_clinical_mss = cbioportal_clinical[cbioportal_clinical$MSI_SENSOR_SCORE<20,]

# Subsetting MSS samples by removing hypermutator samples
# hypermutator threshold from https://doi.org/10.1016/j.cell.2017.09.048
tcga_mss_rmh_samples = cbioportal_clinical_mss$SAMPLE_ID[cbioportal_clinical_mss$TMB_NONSYNONYMOUS<10]

# Create maf files
cbioportal_maf_msi = subsetMaf(cbioportal_maf, tsb=tcga_msi_samples)
cbioportal_maf_mss = subsetMaf(cbioportal_maf, tsb=tcga_mss_samples)
cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh = subsetMaf(cbioportal_maf, tsb=tcga_mss_rmh_samples)

# Find RAS mutant samples
tmpmaf = subsetMaf(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh, genes = c("NRAS", "KRAS"))
cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras = subsetMaf(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh, tsb = tmpmaf@variants.per.sample$Tumor_Sample_Barcode)
# oncoplot(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras, genes = c("TP53", "KRAS", "NRAS"), removeNonMutated = F)
tcga_mss_rmh_ras_samples = cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras@variants.per.sample$Tumor_Sample_Barcode
length(tcga_mss_rmh_ras_samples)

# Find RAS-WT samples
cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_raswt = filterMaf(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh, tsb = tcga_mss_rmh_ras_samples)
# oncoplot(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_raswt, genes = c("TP53", "KRAS", "NRAS"), removeNonMutated = F)
tcga_mss_rmh_raswt_samples = cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_raswt@variants.per.sample$Tumor_Sample_Barcode
length(tcga_mss_rmh_raswt_samples)

# Save Rdata file
# save(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh, cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_raswt, cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras, cbioportal_maf_msi, 
#      file = "../data/250828_Fig1BC_TCGAmafobjects.Rdata")

#write.table(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_raswt@variants.per.sample$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 
 #           file = "../results/Fig1BC_cbioportal_TCGA_MSS_rmhyper_RASWT.txt", #col.names = F, row.names = F, quote = F)
#write.table(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras@variants.per.sample$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 
 #           file = "../results/Fig1BC_cbioportal_TCGA_MSS_rmhyper_RAS.txt", col.names = F, row.names = F, quote = F)
#write.table(cbioportal_maf_msi@variants.per.sample$Tumor_Sample_Barcode, 
  #          file = "../results/supp_cbioportal_TCGA_MSI.txt", col.names = F, #row.names = F, quote = F)

```


```{r fig1bc-prep}

load("250828_Fig1BC_TCGAmafobjects.Rdata")
load("250828_Fig1BC_COLOSSUSmafobject.Rdata")

COLOSSUS_sample_names = as.data.frame(readxl::read_xlsx("COLOSUSS_IDs_Matched.xlsx"))
names(COLOSSUS_sample_names) = c("COLOSSUS_ID", "RCSI_ID")

COLOSSUS_sample_names = COLOSSUS_sample_names[!is.na(COLOSSUS_sample_names$COLOSSUS_ID) &
                                                !is.na(COLOSSUS_sample_names$RCSI_ID),]

cgc = read.table("Fig1BC_CGC_20220314.tsv",
                 sep = "\t",
                 header = T)

top_genes_from_tcga = cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh@gene.summary[["Hugo_Symbol"]][cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh@gene.summary[["Hugo_Symbol"]] %in% cgc$Gene.Symbol][1:20]

top_genes_from_tcga_sorted_by_colossus = colossus_maf_RAS_rmh@gene.summary$Hugo_Symbol[which(colossus_maf_RAS_rmh@gene.summary$Hugo_Symbol %in% top_genes_from_tcga)]

mutation_type_order = c("Missense_Mutation", "Nonsense_Mutation", "In_Frame_Del", "In_Frame_Ins", "Frame_Shift_Del", "Frame_Shift_Ins", "Splice_Site", "Multi_Hit")

```

# Supplementary figure Cobarplot

```{r supp-fig1C}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 4

gene_order = rev(top_genes_from_tcga_sorted_by_colossus)

tmp_cohort_cobarplot=coBarplot(m1=cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras, m2=cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_raswt, m1Name = "TCGA MSS RAS", m2Name = "TCGA MSS RAS-WT", genes = gene_order, colors=vc_cols_v2)


sorted_gene_order = names(sort(abs(colSums(tmp_cohort_cobarplot$m1)-colSums(tmp_cohort_cobarplot$m2)), decreasing = T))[1:15]

#pdf("20260105_TCGA_RAS_mut_left_RAS_wt_right_cobarplot.pdf")
cohort_cobarplot=coBarplot(m1=cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras, m2=cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_raswt, m1Name = "TCGA MSS RAS", m2Name = "TCGA MSS RAS-WT", genes = sorted_gene_order, colors=vc_cols_v2)
annotation_layer_m1 = round(colSums(cohort_cobarplot$m1),1)
#dev.off()



m1_df = as.data.frame(cohort_cobarplot$m1)
m1_df$Mutation_type = rownames(m1_df)
m1_df = pivot_longer(m1_df, cols=1:(ncol(m1_df)-1))
names(m1_df) = c("Mutation_type", "Gene", "Percentage")
m1_df[m1_df==0] = NA
m1_df$Gene = factor(m1_df$Gene, levels = sorted_gene_order)
m1_df$Mutation_type = factor(m1_df$Mutation_type, levels =
c("Missense_Mutation", "Nonsense_Mutation", "In_Frame_Del", "In_Frame_Ins", "Frame_Shift_Del", "Frame_Shift_Ins", "Splice_Site", "Multi_Hit"))

#pdf("20260105_TCGA_RAS_mut_left_side.pdf")
cobarplot_leftside = ggplot(data = m1_df, aes(x = Percentage, y = Gene, fill=Mutation_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", colour="black", show.legend = F) +
  annotate("text", y=names(annotation_layer_m1), x=annotation_layer_m1+5, label=paste0(annotation_layer_m1,"%"), size=4)+
  labs(title= "", x = "Percentage of cases", y = "") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=vc_cols_v2)+
  scale_x_reverse(limits=c(100,0))+
  theme_bw()+publication_theme+
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank()
        )
cobarplot_leftside
#dev.off()

annotation_layer_m2 = round(colSums(cohort_cobarplot$m2),1)

m2_df = as.data.frame(cohort_cobarplot$m2)
m2_df$Mutation_type = rownames(m2_df)
m2_df = pivot_longer(m2_df, cols=1:(ncol(m2_df)-1))
names(m2_df) = c("Mutation_type", "Gene", "Percentage")
m2_df[m2_df==0] = NA
m2_df$Gene = factor(m2_df$Gene, levels = sorted_gene_order)
m2_df$Mutation_type = factor(m2_df$Mutation_type, levels = mutation_type_order)

#pdf("20260105_TCGA_RAS_wildtype_right_side.pdf")
cobarplot_rightside = ggplot(data = m2_df, aes(x = Percentage, y = Gene, fill=Mutation_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", colour="black", show.legend = F) +
  annotate("text", y=names(annotation_layer_m2), x=annotation_layer_m2+5, label=paste0(annotation_layer_m2,"%"), size=4)+
  labs(title= "", x = "Percentage of cases", y = "") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=vc_cols_v2)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,100))+
  theme_bw()+publication_theme+
  theme(axis.text.y=element_blank(),  #remove y axis labels
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),  #remove y axis ticks
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank()
  )
cobarplot_rightside
#dev.off()

#pdf("20260105_TCGA_RAS_wildtype_cobarplot_legend.pdf")
cobarplot_rightside_LEGEND = ggplot(data = m2_df, aes(x = Percentage, y = Gene, fill=Mutation_type)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", colour="black", show.legend = T) +
  annotate("text", y=names(annotation_layer_m2), x=annotation_layer_m2+5, label=paste0(annotation_layer_m2,"%"), size=4)+
  labs(title= "", x = "Percentage of cases", y = "") +
  scale_fill_manual(values=vc_cols_v2)+
  scale_x_continuous(limits=c(0,100))+
  theme_bw()+publication_theme+
  theme(axis.text.y=element_blank(),  #remove y axis labels
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),  #remove y axis ticks
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank()
  )
legend = cowplot::get_legend(cobarplot_rightside_LEGEND)
#dev.off()

#ggsave(filename = "S1E_supp_cobarplot_right.pdf", plot = cobarplot_rightside, width = 6, height = 4)
#ggsave(filename = "S1E_supp_cobarplot_left.pdf", plot = cobarplot_leftside, width = 6, height = 4)

#pdf(file = "S1E_supp_cobarplot_legend.pdf", height = 5, width = 5)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(legend)
#dev.off()
```


# Supplementary figure Variant classification

```{r supp-fig1AB}
#| fig-width: 6
#| fig-height: 5

colossus_variantclassification = sort(colSums(colossus_maf_RAS_rmh@variant.classification.summary[,2:ncol(colossus_maf_RAS_rmh@variant.classification.summary)]), decreasing = T)
tcga_ras_variantclassification = sort(colSums(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras@variant.classification.summary[,2:ncol(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_ras@variant.classification.summary)]), decreasing = T)
tcga_raswt_variantclassification = sort(colSums(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_raswt@variant.classification.summary[,2:ncol(cbioportal_maf_mss_rmh_raswt@variant.classification.summary)]), decreasing = T)

colossus_variantclassification = as.data.frame(cbind(names(colossus_variantclassification), colossus_variantclassification, rep("COLOSSUS", length(colossus_variantclassification))))
tcga_ras_variantclassification = as.data.frame(cbind(names(tcga_ras_variantclassification), tcga_ras_variantclassification, rep("TCGA MSS RAS", length(tcga_ras_variantclassification))))
tcga_raswt_variantclassification = as.data.frame(cbind(names(tcga_raswt_variantclassification), tcga_raswt_variantclassification, rep("TCGA MSS RAS-WT", length(tcga_raswt_variantclassification))))

names(colossus_variantclassification) = c("Variant_classification", "Number_of_variants", "Cohort")
names(tcga_ras_variantclassification) = c("Variant_classification", "Number_of_variants", "Cohort")
names(tcga_raswt_variantclassification) = c("Variant_classification", "Number_of_variants", "Cohort")

variantclassification_ggplotdata = bind_rows(colossus_variantclassification, tcga_ras_variantclassification,tcga_raswt_variantclassification)

variantclassification_ggplotdata$Number_of_variants = as.numeric(variantclassification_ggplotdata$Number_of_variants)

variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification[variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification=="total"] = "Total"
variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification[variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification=="Missense_Mutation"] = "Missense"
variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification[variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification=="Nonsense_Mutation"] = "Nonsense"
variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification[variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification=="Nonstop_Mutation"] = "Nonstop"
variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification[variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification=="Frame_Shift_Del"] = "FS del"
variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification[variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification=="Frame_Shift_Ins"] = "FS ins"
variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification[variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification=="In_Frame_Del"] = "In frame del"
variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification[variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification=="In_Frame_Ins"] = "In frame ins"
variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification[variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification=="Splice_Site"] = "Splice site"
variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification[variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification=="Translation_Start_Site"] = "Transl. start"

variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification = factor(variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification, levels=rev(c("Total", "Missense", "Nonsense", "FS del", "FS ins", "In frame del", "In frame ins", "Splice site", "Transl. start", "Nonstop")))

variantclassification_ggplotdata_p1 = variantclassification_ggplotdata[variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification %in% c("Total", "Missense"),]
variantclassification_ggplotdata_p2 = variantclassification_ggplotdata[!variantclassification_ggplotdata$Variant_classification %in% c("Total", "Missense"),]


publication_theme_variant_classification = theme(
  title = element_text(size = 20),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12)
)

variantclassification_top = ggplot(data=variantclassification_ggplotdata_p1, aes(x=Number_of_variants, y=Variant_classification, fill=Cohort))+
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity", orientation = "y", show.legend = F, col="#000000")+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=colour_dataset_cat)+
  publication_theme_variant_classification+
  labs(title="")+xlab("")+ylab("")

variantclassification_bottom = ggplot(data=variantclassification_ggplotdata_p2, aes(x=Number_of_variants, y=Variant_classification, fill=Cohort))+
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity", orientation = "y", show.legend = T, col="#000000")+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=colour_dataset_cat)+
  publication_theme_variant_classification+
  xlab("Number of variants")+ylab("Variant classification")

variant_classification_plot = plot_grid(variantclassification_top, variantclassification_bottom, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1,2), align = "hv", scale = 1)

variantclassification_top_splitcol = ggplot(data=variantclassification_ggplotdata_p1[variantclassification_ggplotdata_p1$Cohort=="COLOSSUS",], aes(x=Number_of_variants, y=Variant_classification, fill=Cohort))+
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity", orientation = "y", show.legend = F, col="#000000")+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=colour_dataset_cat)+
  publication_theme_variant_classification+
  labs(title="")+xlab("")+ylab("")

variantclassification_bottom_splitcol = ggplot(data=variantclassification_ggplotdata_p2[variantclassification_ggplotdata_p2$Cohort=="COLOSSUS",], aes(x=Number_of_variants, y=Variant_classification, fill=Cohort))+
  geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity", orientation = "y", show.legend = T, col="#000000")+
  theme_bw()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=colour_dataset_cat)+
  publication_theme_variant_classification+
  xlab("Number of variants")+ylab("Variant classification")
```
